<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
forward_fn(config: ModelConfig, *, seq_len: int | None = None, batch_size: int | None = None, family: str | None = None, pack_weights: bool | None = None) -> Callable
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.program`](/api/evoxc-hf/program/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.forward_fn`.

Return the memoised `@evoxc.defn` forward for one static specialisation.

The forward is the whole model pass — `(params, input_ids) -> logits` —
with every weight an ordinary graph **input** (`param_specs`) and all
shapes static. It captures **no parameters** and knows nothing about
backends, devices or compilation: build it here, then stage it with
`evoxc_hf.build`.

Memoised on `(family, config.digest, seq_len, batch_size, pack_weights)`,
so identical calls return the **same** object and `id(fwd)` — the identity
component of `evoxc.build_cached`'s cache key — stays stable. Entries are
built outside the lock (tracing/graph construction is expensive) and
first-insert-wins, so concurrent callers still observe a single object per
key.

The returned object also carries its specialisation as
`fwd._evoxc_hf_specialisation` (`{"family", "digest", "seq_len",
"batch_size", "pack_weights"}`), which `evoxc_hf.build` uses to derive
those values when it is not told them and to reject a mismatch when it is.

## Parameters

- `config` · `ModelConfig` — the static model config (one config = one graph).

- `seq_len` · `int | None` — static sequence length, or `None` for
  `resolve_seq_len`'s default `min(max_position_embeddings, 32)`.

- `batch_size` · `int | None` — static batch size, or `None` for 1.

- `family` · `str | None` — optional explicit family key; when given it must agree with
  `config.family`.

- `pack_weights` · `bool | None` — whether the forward takes the PACKED params inputs
  (`evoxc_hf.pack.PackPlan.specs`, unpacked in-graph as its first
  statement) instead of one input per canonical weight; `None` means
  `False`. Part of the graph's identity: a packed and an unpacked
  forward are different functions.

## Returns

- `Callable` — the `@evoxc.defn`-marked forward `(params, input_ids) -> logits` — not callable eagerly (evoxc never executes a defn); hand it to `evoxc_hf.build`, or to `evoxc.trace` for a custom staging.

## Raises

- `HFConfigError` — `seq_len`/`batch_size` is not a positive integer, or
  `seq_len` exceeds `config.max_position_embeddings`.

- `HFUnsupportedError` — `family` is not a registered family, the config's
  activation is unsupported, or a packed plan cannot be built for a
  non-static config.

- `TypeError` — `config` is not a `~evoxc_hf.config.ModelConfig`,
  `family` disagrees with `config.family` (`HFConfigError`), or
  `pack_weights` is not a bool.
